candidates.change_summary: Replace the require amount from 10 ether to 1 ether, so fallback succeeds only when 1 ether is sent instead of 10.
Replace the require condition that block.timestamp must be strictly greater than pastBlockTime with a condition that it must be equal, altering when the fallback proceeds.
Replace 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1' with 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp', changing the stored future timestamp.
Change the divisor in the block number check from 15 to 20, altering which blocks trigger the balance transfer.
Delete the first require statement, so any msg.value can trigger the fallback instead of requiring exactly 10 ether.
Delete the second require statement, removing the timestamp ordering constraint and allowing immediate successive calls.
Delete the update of pastBlockTime, so pastBlockTime never changes and the call may succeed repeatedly in the same block.
Delete the balance transfer so that the contract keeps ether even on block.number % 15 == 0.
